Include a human hand gently lifting or touching the collar to emphasize finishing and texture. Add a black BADASS wordmark in the upper-right corner and small white product code text 'POKTK740' in the lower-left corner. Use a soft white background with warm directional sunlight and subtle shadows. Technical style: photorealistic apparel detail poster, directional natural light, tactile fabric realism, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
